'''Veda pearls''' were a type of [[Pearl/Legends|pearl]] used as a decorative element in [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]]. [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] wore a [[Shiraya fan headdress/Legends|Shiraya fan headdress]] with [[Color/Legends|white]] veda pearl beading and [[Glass/Legends|glass]] filaments,<ref name="Episode I VD" /> gathered in [[Suspensa/Legends|suspensas]] that encircled her head.<ref name="Episode I" />

{{Substance-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Veda pearls were invented for the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], and were first identified in the associated reference book [[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary|''Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary'']], which was written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]].<ref name="Episode I VD" />
